note: All four displayed identities are fields of Based, and invertibility of the terminal map is in G08.answer. The differences: the existence is conditional on PerBlock (the one-step estimates), and Z is not exhibited as the product L_r...L_{N-1}.

theorem press (hp : H.Selected) (h : Budget H.levels C W) (hr : ∀ d, d+3 ≤ H.levels.clock.J (r d))
    (hc : PerBlock H C r) : ∃ T, Printed H W C Y r T := by

structure Makes : Prop where
  wilson : C.path.Selected
  sections (d : ℕ) : (C.localSection d).Sound C.params
  stages (d : ℕ) :
    d+3 ≤ C.path.levels.clock.J (C.ref d) ∧
    ∀ m, C.ref d ≤ m → d+1 ≤ (C.path.levels.params m).order ∧ d ≤ (C.path.levels.params m).power
  places (d N p : ℕ) : C.ref d ≤ N → ∀ x ∈ (C.localSection d).stencil,
    ∀ i : Axis, 20*((x i).natAbs + 1) ≤ (C.side N p).val
  /-- Section actually gives canonical mask test-size (cf eq:psect).
  Charge this constant before L. -/
  priced (d N p : ℕ) : C.ref d ≤ N →
    let P := C.path.levels.budget N
    let F := C.labels.level d
    let D := C.localSection d
    ∀ o : Site (C.side N p), ∀ i : F.Index,
      P.Regular (D.footprint o) (D.places (Pi.single i 1) o) ∧
      P.supBounds o (D.footprint o) (D.places (Pi.single i 1) o) ((C.path.levels.params N).columns *
        P.threshold^(F.grades i).2)
  calibrated (d N p : ℕ) : C.ref d ≤ N → (C.factory d N p).Based C.params (C.localSection d) (C.ref d)

structure Based (A : Hol G) (C : SectionData F) (r : ℕ) : Prop where
  ref : r ≤ N
  format : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v, (T.entries m v).Format 0 A (H.rep N p m)
  cap : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).remBound 0 (H.rep N p m) (Real.sqrt (H.levels.clock.forcedAllowance m))
      ((H.levels.params m).columns * F.coeffSize (F.core (T.entries m v).x))
  back : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x
  front : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    F.coeffSize (T.entries m v).x ≤ (H.levels.params (m+1)).columns * ((H.S.block m).val : ℝ)^d *
      F.coeffSize (T.entries (m+1) v).x
  linear : ∀ m, r ≤ m → m ≤ N →
    IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).x) ∧ IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).regular) ∧
    IsLinearMap ℂ (fun v => (T.entries m v).forced) ∧ ∀ v, (T.entries m v).support = (T.entries m 0).support
  bare_coord v : (T.entries N v).x = v
  bare_germ v : (T.entries N v).regular = 0
  encode v U : (T.entries N v).density 0 C (H.rep N p N) U =
    ((H.S.a N : ℂ)^d) * ((H.rep N p N).eval U : ℂ) * initial C H N p v 0 U
  unnormalized m : r ≤ m → m < N → ∀ v,
    (T.entries m v).density 0 C (H.rep N p m) =
      ((H.S.block m).val : ℂ)^d • (H.levels.clock.op m p).push (H.β N p (m+1))
        ((T.entries (m+1) v).density 0 C (H.rep N p (m+1)))
  reads v : (T.entries r v).x = T.terminal v
  unit_coord m : r ≤ m → m ≤ N → (T.entries m (unitVec F H N)).x = unitVec F H m
  realForm v : T.terminal (star v) = star (T.terminal v)
  orients (k : Signed) v : T.terminal (F.act k.ortho v) = F.act k.ortho (T.terminal v)
